enrich.rationale: Residual-driven active enrichment will place new solves preferentially in the high-error regions implied by the current winner’s residual structure, yielding better RMSE reduction per sample than blind regeneration or additional hyperparameter search.

diagnosis: RMSE is still dominated by structured, input-correlated residuals (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) with no learning-curve plateau, indicating a sample-coverage bottleneck rather than tuning noise.
